user.title: How does Home Assistant reach your stove?

menu_options.relay: Duepi relay (MyDPRemote server, reads the real power)

cloud.title: Connect to dpremoteiot.com
cloud.description: Enter your dpremoteiot.com account credentials. Your stoves will be discovered automatically.

relay.title: Connect through the Duepi relay
relay.description: Use the server and port shown in the MyDPRemote app settings, and the device code printed on the Wi-Fi module label. The code stays in Home Assistant and is never logged, but the Duepi protocol sends it unencrypted to the relay: treat it like a password.

select_device.title: Select a stove
select_device.description: Choose the stove to add to Home Assistant.

manual_device.title: Enter the device ID
manual_device.description: No stove could be discovered automatically. Enter its dpremoteiot.com device ID.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Please re-enter your credentials.

error.invalid_device: The configured device was not found or returned invalid data.
error.server_error: The dpremoteiot.com service is temporarily unavailable.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests to dpremoteiot.com. Please try again later.
error.relay_cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Duepi relay. Check the server and port shown in MyDPRemote.
error.relay_invalid_code: The stove did not answer with this device code. Check the code on the Wi-Fi module label.
error.invalid_device_code: The device code is 4 to 32 letters or digits, as printed on the Wi-Fi module label.

error.invalid_pellet_range: The minimum pellet rate cannot be greater than the maximum rate.

stove_off.message: The stove is not heating. Turn it on, or wait for it to reach stable heating, before changing the power.

start_refused.message: The stove cannot be started now: it is busy (cleaning or shutting down), reports an error, a start was requested less than a minute ago, or the integration was loaded less than a minute ago.
